detail_arrival_value_car: Car/motorbike: Free parking on the entire Klosterweg
detail_catering_value: Food and drink will be provided! There will be barbecue food (vegan/vegetarian/meat), alcoholic and non-alcoholic cocktails and draught beer. Salads and cakes are welcome as bring-along item.
detail_faq_0_value: You are very welcome to bring food. Barbecues, salads and cakes are very welcome. Everything is available in terms of drinks. If you have an interesting game or something similar, you are also welcome to bring it along!
detail_faq_1_value: Your presence is the greatest gift! If you still want to give a gift, I would be happy about a donation for the drinks and food. Of course, I am still happy to receive creative gifts :D
detail_faq_2_title: Is it possible to stay overnight?
detail_faq_2_value: Unfortunately, there are only very limited places to sleep and only for people outside Karlsruhe. If you need a place to sleep, please let me know when you register and join the Bettbörse.
detail_faq_3_title: Can I offer a bed for the night?
detail_faq_3_value: As long as you live within Karlsruhe, this is possible. Please indicate this when you register and join the Bettbörse.
detail_faq_4_title: Is there a place where you can plan to travel together by car?
detail_faq_4_value: Yes, there is a group for this where you can exchange ideas: Carpooling
detail_faq_5_title: How does the team battle work?
detail_faq_5_value: Each guest receives a team membership (red/blue) and 5 tokens when registering. These can be bet for various games. The more tokens a team has in proportion to the opposing team at the end, the more the team wins from the prize.
detail_faq_6_title: Is there vegatarian food and what about allergens?
detail_faq_6_value: Vegetarian food is planned alongside meat dishes. There will also be vegan options. Please let me know when you register if you have a vegan lifestyle so that we can plan better. If you have any intolerances or allergies, please let me know - then I can tell you what you can eat without hesitation.
detail_faq_7_value: YES! You will have the best night of your life! Whether old or young, big or small, nerdy or party, you will have fun!
detail_program_value_0: 06:00pm - Admission: Arrive, grab a drink, meet people
detail_program_value_1: 06:30pm - Official starting signal: short welcome from Elias - then off we go
detail_program_value_3: From the start until 12:00am - Birthday quiz: grab your sheet at check-in
detail_program_value_4: 08:00pm - Olympics: a short team-battle olympiad (30 min)
detail_program_value_5: 09:00pm - DJ rave with paulstdtr: dancefloor on the rooftop terrace
detail_program_value_6: 12:00am - Countdown, closing speech by Elias & reveal of the team-battle winner
detail_program_value_7: Afterwards - OpenEnd - the evening ends as you like

home_testimonial_0_cite: A quarter of a century with Elias is an exciting adventure full of laughter, good spirits and unforgettable moments that make life colourful and vibrant. And that goes for more than just his birthday parties!
home_testimonial_1_cite: If Elias put as much effort into his studies as he puts into his birthday parties, he would have a doctorate by now.
home_testimonial_2_cite: Elias' birthday is not just any birthday. Live music, games of skill, secret missions, collaborative creative projects, but of course also barbecue and drinks at the bar make the day a special reunion for everyone who may call themselves a friend or relative of Elias.
home_testimonial_3_cite: Whoever doesn't know Elias and his birthdays has really missed out on something in life!
home_testimonial_4_cite: Last year I got to see up close how much love and energy Elias puts into his birthday. This day is very special to him, which is why he tries his best to make it an unforgettable event for every single guest.
home_testimonial_5_cite: Who needs Tinder when you can meet hot singles from the Mannheim area at Elias' birthday?

privacy_cookies_body: This website does not use any analytics tools or tracking of any kind. Only functional cookies are used. These are small text files stored by your web browser on your device. They help retain certain settings—such as language or display preferences—and recognize you when you return. This ensures that logged-in sessions remain active, so you don’t have to log in every time you visit. Cookies remain on your device for up to one year unless you delete them manually. Most modern web browsers allow you to monitor, limit, or block the use of cookies. Many can also be configured to automatically delete cookies when the browser is closed. Please note that disabling cookies may limit the functionality of this website.
privacy_data_body: When simply visiting this website, only the cookies listed below are collected. These cookies are not stored on the server but are saved exclusively on your local device. The website contains buttons labeled “By clicking, you confirm the privacy policy.” By clicking these buttons, the data you enter on the website is transmitted to the server and stored there. Further information about this process can be found in the next section. Access to this data is granted exclusively to the operator of the website, as named in the legal notice. The data is used solely to process your request and will not be shared with third parties without your explicit consent. Consent for making your personal data publicly visible can be granted after registration via the “Public in guest list” button. In this case, all information you have provided will be publicly accessible. Collecting this data is generally necessary to plan the event appropriately. All stored data will be permanently deleted no later than one week after the end of the event.
privacy_data_title: What data is collected by this website?
privacy_registration_body: When you submit a form, the entered data is transmitted in encrypted form to a server located in Frankfurt am Main (Germany) and securely stored in a database. Primarily, only the data visibly entered into the form is stored. In addition, only two further pieces of information are collected: an anonymous user ID and the timestamp of the registration. The website also offers the option to sign in via external providers (e.g., Google). If you register using such a button, the website gains access to your email address stored with the provider as well as publicly available profile data. Only your email address is stored and used for registration or login purposes. Upon personal request to the operator’s email address listed in the legal notice (imprint), all stored personal data can be provided.
privacy_registration_title: How the data provided is processed and stored?
privacy_rights_body: According to DSGVO and BDSG, you can request information, updating, blocking or deletion of all your data at any time. Your contact person for this is the above-mentioned operator of this website. In addition, I am obliged to remind you of your right to object to this consent at any time and, if necessary, to complain to a supervisory authority about me.
